policy.spelling: Both integrated numbered-lesson Spelling & Word Study Labs AND a separately scheduled weekly spelling/retrieval routine. Only lessons matched to a word-study objective introduce a new rule/set. Other weekly sets are topic/text-linked and not disguised as unrelated lesson challenges.
policy.websiteIntegration: future connector receives events and challenge/spelling IDs; local lesson does not claim server sync
policy.challengeAllocation: One primary Challenge chosen from lesson learning objective; not chosen to equalize counts.
policy.spellingSetLifecycle: intro > teach pattern and exceptions > link spelling to meaning and contextual use > independent test > save bankId and attempt > revisit asynchronously in website Spelling Library without replaying lesson
policy.wordStudySelectionGuard: Before producing a word study lesson, Run 1 must name the taught word rule or meaningful word family, assess relevance to the lesson objective, and validate words and exceptions. If no meaningful spelling focus can be justified, use Language & Editing instead.
policy.masterTemplateStatus: No shared template change authorised; Lesson Y7-001 remains Reading Detective.
